title: Cinematic
description: A stills-based cinematic: painted plates, one camera move per shot, crossfades between them. Direction and the reason behind every constraint live in brand/CINEMATIC_DIRECTION.md; the story it tells lives in brand/STORY_BIBLE.md. Shape only is enforced here -- tools/validate_cinematics.mjs owns the checks that need to read the PNGs and the string bundles.

id.description: Stable id. Matches the filename and the DataManager.PATHS key.

shots.description: Played in order. brand/CINEMATIC_DIRECTION.md caps total runtime at 60s.

hold.description: Seconds this shot is on screen, transitions excluded. 3.0-7.0 is the film's range; the ceiling here is a guard, not a target.

caption.description: i18n key for the one caption line, or null for a wordless shot. Must exist in every locale bundle. Max 8 words (BRAND_SYSTEM.md 4.2) -- counted by the validator against the English bundle.

captionDelay.description: Seconds into the hold before the caption arrives. Defaults to 0.4. A caption never crosses a transition, so the validator rejects one that cannot land and leave inside the hold.

move.description: The camera: a source rect on the plate at the start of the hold, and another at the end. A held shot is a move of zero length -- from and to are the same rect -- so there is no second case for the runtime or the validator to get wrong. Both rects are 16:9 and must stay inside every layer, including the plate's camera bleed.

layers.description: Back to front. Two or three is the house style; more costs bytes and buys little.

transition.description: Crossfade out of this shot, in seconds. Defaults to the cine_fade duration, 0.9.

music.description: Music key from audio_manifest.json to cross-fade to at the top of this shot, or null to leave whatever is playing alone.

sfx.description: Sound-event name from sound_events.json, or null. Every sound in the film is a flourish -- a missing SFX must never cost a fact.

sfxAt.description: Seconds into the hold to fire `sfx`. Ignored when sfx is null.

src.description: res:// path without the prefix, as everywhere else in godot/data. Plates live under assets/cinematics/<cinematic id>/, and carry a 64px camera bleed on every side that no rect enters.

size.description: Authored pixel size [w, h], verified against the real PNG. Declaring it means a plate redrawn at the wrong size fails the build instead of quietly reframing every shot it is in.

parallax.description: Share of the camera's translation this layer takes. 1.0 moves with the frame; lower lags and reads as further away. Defaults to 1.0; never above it.

drift.description: Slow sine loop [x, y] in pixels, phase-offset per layer index. Ceiling 5px: above that it stops reading as air.

rect.description: [x, y, w, h] in plate pixels.
